genesis.10.p1.b1.text: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.

genesis.10.p1.b2.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

genesis.10.p1.b3.text: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.

genesis.10.p2.b4.text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

genesis.10.p2.b5.text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD …

genesis.10.p2.b6.text: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

genesis.10.p2.b7.text: … Later the Canaanite clans were scattered …

genesis.10.p3.b8.text: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.

genesis.10.p3.b9.text: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided …

genesis.10.p3.b10.text: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
